feature: Website shell, ordinary navigation, mobile menu and theme
finding: Header/footer navigation and mobile drawer work; light/dark preference survives reload. This is the navigation shell, not a certification of every destination or accessibility.
next_step: Retain regression coverage for signed-in and mobile navigation.

finding: Live residences are loaded from the database and rendered as catalogue cards. Paused/pending items are omitted from the public catalogue; direct-booking enforcement is a separate defect.
next_step: Add tests for large and empty catalogues.

finding: Basic city/capacity/type/price filters exist. Choosing Ikoyi also matches every Lagos residence because the predicate ORs area with city. Dates and flexible-date availability do not filter results; category tabs raise a missing-element error.
next_step: Use explicit city/area identifiers and authoritative date availability; fix tab handlers.

finding: Price ascending/descending and rating sorting are implemented on the loaded catalogue; ascending price was exercised successfully. “Newest” is only a new flag, not a publication-date ranking.
next_step: Add stable tie-breaking and a real date field if chronological newest is required.

finding: Collection tiles, descriptions and member counts render, but selecting a collection does not restrict the stays list to its mapped properties.
next_step: Apply COLLECTION_MAP when parsing col-* filters.

finding: Established seeded homes render amenities, images and reviews. A pre-existing unreviewed listing and both newly created/published test listings fell back to the 404 UI: Object.entries(p.scores) receives null. Host identity/contact presentation is also hardcoded.
next_step: Provide defaults for optional listing data and render the actual owner and property details.

finding: An illustrated map and clickable pins exist, but the map has 12 hardcoded property pins, does not represent new listings, and map.php initially opens the list instead of the map.
next_step: Generate pins from actual coordinates and filtered results; initialize map mode correctly.

finding: Date widgets render, and final submission rejects overlaps with existing active reservations. Frontend calendars use sold-out demo ranges rather than JL.blocked; host date blocks are not enforced by booking availability.
next_step: Unify calendar display and booking checks around bookings plus owner blocks, with transactional conflict protection.

feature: True 360-degree tours and property-specific floor plans
finding: The “360°” viewer pans/zooms a single ordinary image. Floor plans are generic generated SVGs, not uploaded or measured layouts for each residence.
next_step: Integrate real panoramas/property plans or relabel these as illustrative previews.

finding: Database-backed guide and article pages load, including all six neighbourhood and six journal detail routes in the fixture. Editorial accuracy and fresh content are outside this technical check.
next_step: Keep published content and metadata accurate; fix collection/search destinations separately.

finding: FAQ keyword search produces matching answers and the accordion expands/collapses. This does not imply that the support, dispute or emergency services described there are implemented.
next_step: Keep answers aligned with implemented capabilities.

finding: Published review text and aggregate data display. Individual reviews are drawn with five stars regardless of their actual score, some metrics are fixed, “verified completed stay” is not enforced consistently, and AI summaries are stored text rather than generated on review submission.
verification: reviews route; A55-A57, M05; source review
next_step: Render real individual ratings and metrics; unify verified-stay eligibility before making trust claims.

feature: About, hosting information and roadmap pages
finding: Informational pages render correctly from templates/catalogue data. Roadmap items labelled future/research are informational, not evidence that those capabilities exist.
next_step: Remove inaccurate live-service assertions; keep roadmap status honest.

feature: Email/password guest and owner registration, login and logout
finding: Valid registration creates a hashed-password account and session; invalid signup is rejected. Browser login and logout work, and signup cannot grant the admin role. Suspension and MFA are separate failed controls below.
next_step: Retest after tightening suspension and MFA requirements.

finding: The current password, minimum length and confirmation are checked; the new hash persists and fresh login with the new password succeeds. This is not forgotten-password recovery or global session revocation.
next_step: Add session/token revocation policy and browser regression coverage.

finding: No reset-token issuance, recovery email or reset endpoint is supplied. Help/forgot-password links are not a recovery workflow.
next_step: Implement expiring, single-use reset tokens and real recovery delivery.

finding: Email/password is the implemented authentication path. Social/phone methods named in the frontend constants have no provider callbacks or OTP flows and are not implemented by the current sign-in form; admSSO is explicitly a stub.
next_step: Implement providers securely or remove/disable unavailable sign-in options.

finding: Profile display and profile-update APIs work, but the account page lacks a wired profile edit form. Currency works; language and marketing/WhatsApp preference controls are not saved.
next_step: Expose and wire profile editing and persist each preference separately.

feature: Identity verification, selfie checks and document vault
finding: KYC is a flag, not a verification workflow. Manage Documents only shows a toast; no secure document upload, selfie matching, reviewer evidence or vault implementation is supplied. Admin “verify” just sets flags.
next_step: Remove unearned verification claims; implement a genuine verification/evidence process.

finding: Phone presence is treated as “Phone verified”; emailVerified is inferred from an admin-set status label. There is no email-token or phone-OTP verification path.
next_step: Track verified timestamps only after independent verification challenges.

finding: Every account is shown “SMS + authenticator”; there is no enrolment, secret/challenge, recovery-code or enforcement workflow. Manage Security only toasts.
next_step: Do not claim enabled 2FA until enrolment and enforcement exist.

finding: The account page says export and erase are ready, but no corresponding user workflow or endpoint is supplied. Admin CSV downloads are not personal-data export/erasure.
next_step: Implement identity-checked export and retention-aware deletion; obtain compliance review.

finding: NGN/USD/GBP/EUR display conversion uses stored rates; the selected currency persists on reload. This does not provide FX settlement or a live exchange-rate feed: reservations are recorded in NGN.
next_step: Label rates/display currency accurately and separate them from charging currency.

finding: A language dropdown is displayed but has no persistence or localized UI/content pipeline. Concierge language claims are not website localization.
next_step: Implement localization and saved language preference or remove the control.

finding: The complete browser wizard creates a booking and confirmation. Selected detail-page dates/policy are lost on navigation; returning to the first step breaks date-change binding. Confirmation does not depend on payment.
next_step: Preserve wizard state, rebind inputs and gate confirmation on verified payment/approval.

finding: Past dates and existing reservation overlaps are rejected, with ownership checks on web actions. Host-blocked and paused listings can still be booked; excess occupancy is silently clamped and the client can choose the cancellation policy.
next_step: Validate live status, blocks, capacity, policy and minimum stay server-side; add MySQL concurrency tests.

feature: Quotes, promotions, long-stay discounts and add-on pricing
finding: Server-side totals and frozen breakdowns are real. Client promo math differs from PHP, calendar/rule prices are ignored, and admin campaigns do not create checkout promos. Tested JOLLOF10 quote differed by ₦10,548.
next_step: Use one authoritative quote service, connect pricing inputs and revalidate totals before charging.

feature: Actual payment collection and gateway verification
finding: No gateway charge/verification/webhook flow is supplied. Booking creates an initiated payment row, labels escrow held and can immediately mark a reservation confirmed. Choosing Card/Paystack/Flutterwave/USSD/etc. does not collect funds.
next_step: Integrate provider test mode, signed webhooks, amount/currency verification and idempotent payment state.

feature: Real escrow, refunds and host transfers
finding: Escrow/released/refunded/paid are database labels. Check-in and cancellation change these labels without moving money; there is no custodial settlement/refund/payout implementation.
next_step: Implement reconciled ledger and provider-supported settlement/refund/payout processes; remove unsupported escrow claims.

finding: A split flag halves the initial recorded amount, but no second charge, mandate or deposit authorization/release exists. A three-night booking can request a feature described as 30+-night-only.
next_step: Implement staged collection and deposit lifecycle with eligibility validation.

finding: Own reservations render on reload and are separated by status. Mutation refresh reads the wrong response shape, leaving displayed status stale; some trip messaging/key details are hardcoded.
next_step: Fix state synchronization and derive trip details from actual booking data.

finding: Requests are stored as booking events/enquiries. The booking dates/price are not changed and no host approval/application workflow exists, despite copy promising immediate rate adjustment.
next_step: Add validated proposal, approval, repricing and payment/refund reconciliation.

finding: Cancellation changes booking/payment labels and releases the reservation. It does not calculate the advertised policy-based refund or actually refund; reversing points does not create a compensating ledger entry.
next_step: Calculate policy-based amounts, perform provider refunds and reconcile points and inventory atomically.

finding: Status transitions persist, but a future unpaid reservation can be checked in immediately without date or access-code validation, releasing the escrow label and marking the payment paid. UI refresh is stale.
next_step: Enforce schedule, payment and confirmation rules before transitions; record immutable evidence.

finding: A code is generated/stored, but no lock-provider provisioning, activation or expiry occurs. Trips also display a fixed 4471# code while claiming smart-lock synchronization.
next_step: Hide access claims until a real device lifecycle has been integrated and tested.

finding: An ownership-protected printable HTML invoice uses the frozen server quote and supports browser Save as PDF. The payments page includes invented receipts; no automatic PDF attachment service exists, and the client invoice preview uses current prices. Unauthorized GET content is withheld but incorrectly returns HTTP 200.
next_step: Use one immutable invoice source, remove invented receipts and return appropriate HTTP statuses.

feature: Digital lease agreements for long stays
finding: The UI claims an automatically signed/stored lease, but the agreement action only toasts and there is no document-generation/e-signature/vault workflow.
next_step: Build an auditable agreement workflow or remove the promise.

finding: A Google Calendar template link exists, but it uses today+7/today+10 rather than selected reservation dates. Calendar/Wallet connection and automatic pass-generation claims are unsupported; no wallet-pass generator is supplied.
next_step: Generate actual reservation events and passes; do not show fictitious connected states.

finding: Experience submission saves an enquiry and attempts email; it does not create an experience booking, reserve inventory or collect payment. The API accepts a past date and 9,999 guests. Stay add-ons can affect price, but supplier fulfilment is absent.
next_step: Distinguish enquiry from booking, validate capacity/dates and add fulfilment/availability workflow.

finding: Creation and balance lookup work as database operations, but cards can be issued unfunded, balances are not debited on checkout, any sufficiently long UI code grants ₦60,000, and arbitrary numeric credit can zero a reservation.
next_step: Implement paid issuance and atomic authenticated redemption; never accept client-declared gift value.

finding: Basic saving and list records persist. New list creation reads r.slug instead of r.data.slug and cannot refresh state; saved items can receive a “Removed” toast because r.saved is read from the wrong level.
next_step: Align response envelopes and rehydrate named lists immediately after mutation.

finding: Server-side add/remove and comparison persistence exist, including a four-item limit. The browser reads r.compare rather than r.data.compare, so an add does not update the displayed comparison until reload.
next_step: Use the returned compare array and update tray/table synchronously.

finding: Account enrolment and duplicate prevention work. No cancellation/availability worker or price-drop monitor sends the promised future alerts.
next_step: Implement monitored availability matching, notifications and unsubscribe/expiry controls.

feature: Loyalty points, ledger and tier progression
finding: Points and ledger rows are written and displayed, but are awarded before payment; cancellations leave ledger and balance inconsistent. Tier promotion is not implemented. Progress parses “10,000 points” as 10 instead of using minPts.
verification: A64; membership route; seeded tier calculation check
next_step: Award only on settled eligible activity, use reversing ledger entries and implement threshold-based tier changes.

finding: Redeem buttons only show a success toast. No balance check/deduction, redemption record, inventory reservation or fulfilment is performed.
next_step: Implement atomic debit and redemption/fulfilment records before showing success.

finding: Real account referral codes are generated and can be shared from membership, but the referral centre displays a fixed code and fixed statistics. There is no referral attribution, qualification, bilateral credit or affiliate commission/payout engine.
next_step: Implement attribution and qualified-reward ledger; remove sample code/statistics.

feature: In-app notification feed and read/unread state
finding: Notifications are stored per account, displayed, and can be marked read/all-read with persisted state. This is the internal feed, not external push/SMS delivery.
next_step: Add pagination and retention tests for long-lived accounts.

finding: A preference API exists, but the browser sends on while PHP reads value, so enabling a setting saves 0. Modal defaults and delivery-channel descriptions do not reflect stored choices.
next_step: Use stable preference keys, load persisted values and apply them to delivery workers.

finding: The UI claims these channels are on; only a mobile push-token storage field is provided. No actual dispatch integration or scheduled reminder/price-drop delivery is supplied.
next_step: Integrate providers, consent, queues, retries and delivery receipts.

finding: The real footer/API signup validates email, deduplicates and stores subscribers. This does not include newsletter sending; the separate Journal top Subscribe control is only a toast.
verification: A23; B23 identifies the separate stub
next_step: Wire the Journal button to the existing subscription flow and use consent-aware mailing tools.

finding: Booking/welcome/enquiry/invoice mail code exists using PHP mail or a minimal SMTP client. Delivery was intentionally disabled in the audit, so no deliverability claim is made. Several callers ignore send results; the SMTP client does not validate SMTP reply status codes.
verification: A50; source review; external transport untested
next_step: Test with a mail sandbox, validate SMTP replies and queue/retry/report failures accurately.

feature: Inbox, concierge/support messages and host chat
finding: Own conversation messages persist and concierge can reply. A listing’s Message CTA opens concierge instead of the intended host, because the binder ignores the query; new users have no host thread. No real-time transport, operator reply console, media/translation pipeline or genuine read-receipt workflow is supplied. Stored text is rendered as HTML on reopening a thread.
next_step: Escape/sanitize messages, bind the chosen thread, model both participants and implement delivery/read workflows.

finding: A useful catalogue/rule-based responder works; an optional external model hook exists. It does not actually book, arrange suppliers or translate chat. Availability intent uses a fixed near-term window rather than the requested dates, and fallback replies overstate implemented services.
verification: A26, A27; concierge route; external model untested
next_step: Keep answers grounded in authoritative inventory and capabilities; add controlled, confirmed actions if desired.

finding: No implementations were found for the claimed collaborative recommendations, visual search, predictive pricing, automatic review summarisation, listing A/B optimisation, translation, sustainability scoring or automated risk models. Simple rules and stored text should not be presented as those services.
next_step: Remove “all live” claims or implement and evaluate each capability separately.

feature: Disputes, community reporting/blocking and emergency actions
finding: File dispute, report concern and blocked-user controls only toast. Emergency buttons also only say “Dialling/connecting” and do not initiate a call. The separate inbox concierge tel: link is real but does not implement these controls.
next_step: Remove false safety confirmations immediately; implement reporting/case workflows and real emergency links.

finding: Owner signup creates the role/ownership flag, payout-settings row, channel rows and default templates; the owner workspace loads. This provisioning is not evidence of live channels, KYC or payouts.
next_step: Test customer-to-owner upgrade alongside new-owner provisioning.

finding: The wizard creates pending listings, but selected city/type/policy are omitted by wizGather and submitted as Lagos/Apartment/moderate. Minimum stay, discount/rule selections and some other fields are not carried through; approved unreviewed listings can break detail rendering.
verification: A30, B28; failed new-listing detail routes
next_step: Define a complete validated listing schema and persist every editable field with safe defaults.

finding: Local files produce browser blob previews, but submission sends only filenames and the API stores those names. No binary upload/storage pipeline exists; the resulting uploaded-photo URL returned 404.
next_step: Implement authenticated multipart uploads, validation, durable storage and gallery URLs.

finding: Wizard state exists only in a JavaScript object; refreshing loses title/progress despite the explicit “Progress is never lost” promise.
next_step: Persist versioned drafts server-side and restore them per account.

feature: Manage listing base price and publication status
finding: Owners can update their own base price and pause/resume an approved listing, with cross-owner protection. Full detail/media editing is absent and pausing does not stop direct API reservations.
next_step: Provide complete listing editing and enforce status in every booking path.

feature: Calendar blocking, per-date prices and pricing rules
finding: Month navigation, day/bulk overrides and rule records persist. Guest availability and Pricing::quote do not consume them: a blocked day remained bookable and a ₦400,000 override with +50% rule still quoted the ₦155,000 base rate.
next_step: Integrate owner calendar/rules into one authoritative quote/availability engine.

finding: Pending requests can be recorded and listed, but the owner workspace has no approve/decline workflow. Admin has a transition endpoint; mobile incorrectly lets the guest approve their own request. No automatic 24-hour expiry job was found.
next_step: Add host-owned decision endpoints/UI and expiry rules; prevent guest self-approval.

feature: Host dashboard, analytics and earnings forecasts
finding: Dashboard data is queried by owner and charts/what-if tools render. “90-day” occupancy uses all sold nights divided by 90, financial figures include uncollected reservations, and the home-page earnings estimator omits the thousands multiplier used correctly on the host page.
next_step: Define time windows and settled-money metrics consistently; correct estimator units.

finding: Invite/revoke records are saved and displayed, but no invitation delivery/acceptance, co-host account linkage or effective delegated permissions are implemented.
next_step: Implement expiring invitations and enforce scoped team permissions on every endpoint.

finding: Templates can be created, edited, removed and viewed for the signed-in owner; browser editing persisted and reloaded. Automatic use of those templates is a separate missing feature.
next_step: Add full create/delete regression coverage and placeholder validation.

finding: Triggers can be selected and stored, but no job or booking-event consumer sends the configured templates.
next_step: Implement idempotent trigger processing and scheduled delivery.

finding: Connect simply changes a database flag and last-sync time, then claims availability syncs both ways. No credentials, provider API, iCal import/export or synchronization worker is supplied.
next_step: Do not claim connected until a real integration authenticates and successfully synchronizes.

finding: Bank name/account name/schedule and the last four digits are stored, and history can be read/exported. The full account/beneficiary information and bank validation needed to actually pay an owner are absent; no transfer execution exists.
next_step: Create verified provider beneficiaries and reconcile actual transfers before showing paid balances.

feature: Inspection, photography/tour scheduling and AI listing rewrite
finding: These action buttons only toast; they do not create appointments, contact photographers or rewrite/save listing content. “KYC complete” and listing-optimisation suggestions are static.
next_step: Implement real service requests/content generation or label these as unavailable.

finding: Ordinary guests are denied admin pages/actions. The dedicated admin login can check a configured static OTP, but the ordinary login authenticates an admin without that OTP even when the option is enabled. The tracked configuration currently disables admin 2FA.
next_step: Enforce MFA centrally for every admin authentication path, including mobile; replace shared static OTP with actual MFA.

feature: User search and manual verification management
finding: Loaded users can be searched and status/KYC flags can be changed. Only the first 200 are loaded with no paging; verification is not backed by an identity workflow and role assignment is not a complete permissions editor.
next_step: Add paginated user management and an evidence-backed verification/role workflow.

finding: Suspend updates users.status, but login/mobile authorization inspect users.status_level. A freshly suspended synthetic account could sign in again; existing sessions are not revoked by this action.
next_step: Use one enforced account-state model; revoke sessions/tokens and block suspended users everywhere.

finding: Pending listings appear in the queue; approve/reject persists status, audit entries and owner notifications. The preview link returns 404 for pending listings, reviewer notes are not collected, mobile can publish without approval, and newly approved listings can crash their public page.
next_step: Provide authenticated preview, require moderation consistently and validate publish-ready data.

finding: Admin publication/rejection persists and recalculates non-empty published aggregates. Rejecting the last published review leaves its old rating and review count in place rather than resetting them. Mobile review eligibility is also weaker than web.
next_step: Reset zero-review aggregates, calculate category scores consistently and unify submission eligibility.

finding: Campaign records save and can be edited. Checkout reads promos, not campaigns, so creating a Live campaign does not create a usable discount. Revenue attribution/scheduling is not implemented by those records.
next_step: Unify campaign and promo rules, dates, eligibility, limits and redemption attribution.

finding: CMS blocks can be created, edited and toggled in the back office. Public templates do not consume those blocks; publishing a unique test block did not change the home page. No full journal/property content editor is provided.
next_step: Map block keys to actual pages and implement preview/publication behavior.

finding: Stored flags can be listed, resolved or relabelled escalated. No risk-signal producer/AI scoring engine or risk-team notification workflow was found; an empty list is not proof that the platform is safe.
next_step: Implement real signals, case ownership and escalation; remove unsupported live-AI assurances.

feature: Admin and owner CSV record exports
finding: All eight supplied admin CSVs and both owner CSVs returned data in CSV form. Admin access and host ownership scoping exist. These export stored records, not independently verified cash, remittances or accounting statements.
next_step: Add accounting reconciliation, spreadsheet-formula hardening and large-export tests.

finding: Actions generate database log records which can be viewed/exported. The claimed “immutable” log is an ordinary mutable table without append-only/tamper-evidence controls; not every business claim is backed by a real audited operation.
verification: R08; admin audit route; source review
next_step: Define audited events and protect logs with restricted append-only storage and retention.

feature: Corporate demo requests, company travel portal and consolidated billing
finding: The business demo button does not submit anything; corporate metrics are fixed. No company/team travel portal, purchase-order workflow, departmental policy engine or consolidated invoice implementation is supplied.
next_step: Start with a real enquiry form; build company/employee/billing models before promising a corporate portal.

feature: Native mobile app and store distribution
finding: This checkout includes backend mobile endpoints and an app marketing page, not an Android/iOS application build. Store buttons say demo/coming soon rather than linking to installable builds. Biometrics and voice-assistant booking are not supplied.
next_step: Treat the app as unshipped until native artifacts and distribution links are delivered.

finding: Bearer login, token revocation, catalogue/member sync and sequential booking replay work. Message-send and notifications-read return 500 against the supplied schema (read_at does not exist). Review eligibility, host moderation and approval authorization differ from web; repeat wishlist replay toggles twice.
next_step: Share schema and centralized authorization/business validation; make replay atomic and endpoint/payload scoped.

finding: The shared refresh function expects r.data, while state.php sends the mutable state under r.state. The refresh therefore does not hydrate the client. Individual optimistic/reload-based paths can still work, but this common refresh mechanism does not.
next_step: Standardize the JSON contract and test every mutation through to the repainted screen.

feature: Clean installation from this repository alone
finding: The supplied installer is already locked and references ../database/schema.sql and ../database/seed.sql, which are not included. A private-data-bearing MySQL dump is not a safe substitute for an installation schema/migration package.
next_step: Ship safe schema/migrations/seed data, environment-based config and installation/deployment documentation.

feature: SEO metadata, sitemap and clean URLs
finding: Titles/descriptions/OG metadata and sitemap.php exist. Canonicals strip query parameters, making distinct /stay.php?p=... pages share a canonical. robots.txt points to absent sitemap.xml, and pretty detail URLs lack supplied rewrite rules. In the isolated server, /stay/onyx resolved to the home page, not the listing.
next_step: Ship server rewrites, correct canonical detail URLs and sitemap location; improve server-rendered public content.

finding: Seven key pages had no horizontal overflow at 390px and the menu worked. Five axe WCAG scans still found serious contrast failures and critical missing form/select/button accessible names, plus missing image text. No screen-reader, Safari/iOS or comprehensive keyboard audit was performed.
next_step: Fix semantic controls/labels, contrast, focus and keyboard behavior; test additional browsers/devices.
